study: forward journal for H11 (revenue) and H16 (momentum confirmation)

inference.why: a monthly journal is inspected many times; fixed-sample p-values are only valid for a pre-committed number of looks
inference.sigma_source: back-solved from the historical runs; frozen, never re-estimated

planning_only_not_evidence.note: planning only, not evidence; effect comes from already-inspected history (winner's curse) and required periods scale with 1/effect^2

snapshot_freshness.rebuild_command: python run_pipeline.py --mode daily  →  python scripts/db_to_parquet.py --out data/research

m18_reminder: inspecting this journal and then changing the model turns all prior forward data into development data for the new model
